summary: BrokerOS Phase 1 Ext 5 + Login Toast tested. Found and fixed a critical bug in Login.js where commission reminder toast never fired due to wrong API response data path (data.overdue vs data.data.overdue). After fix, all toast tests pass. Lender filter panel (Find a Lender) is fully functional with all specified features. One design issue identified: 'Clear & Close' button is visually blocked by the Emergent preview badge (z-index:9999) at 1080px viewport but the button IS functional (confirmed via JS dispatch).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Clear & Close' button in the filter panel footer is visually blocked by the 'Made with Emergent' badge (z-index:9999) at 1080px viewport height. The badge rect (x=1726, y=1024, w=178, h=40) fully overlaps the button (x=1717, y=1044, w=87, h=20). Confirmed via elementFromPoint. The button IS functional (verified via JS dispatch) but a real user at 1080px cannot click it. Fix: increase filter panel z-index above 9999 (currently z-50), OR add pointer-events:none to badge, OR adjust panel footer positioning.

issues: 'Clear & Close' button at panel bottom-right is obscured by Emergent badge (z-index:9999) at 1080px resolution. Panel uses z-50 which is lower than badge's z-index 9999. Recommend increasing filter panel z-index or adjusting badge pointer-events.

action_items: Increase filter panel z-index above 9999 to ensure 'Clear & Close' button is clickable above the Emergent badge at all viewport heights. Current panel z-index is z-50 (50), badge is 9999.
Note: Commission reminder toast bug was FIXED in this iteration (Login.js data path corrected)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in this iteration: Login.js lines 33-37: axios .then({data}) destructures the HTTP response body (which is {success, data:{overdue,due_soon}}). Code was accessing data.overdue instead of data.data.overdue, causing overdueCount=0 and dueSoonCount=0 always, silently skipping the toast. Fixed to const reminders = data.data; then reminders?.overdue/.due_soon.

Filter panel z-index (z-50 = 50) is lower than the Emergent preview badge (z-index: 9999). This causes the 'Clear & Close' button to be blocked. Fix: add style={{zIndex: 10000}} to the filter panel wrapper to ensure it sits above the badge.

handleMatchLenders in Lenders.js makes a full API call (?page=1&limit=1000) on every Match Lenders click to fetch ALL lenders for client-side filtering. With large datasets this is inefficient; consider server-side filtering endpoint.
The Toaster component in Layout.js uses duration={4000} as default but toast.custom() in Login.js overrides to 6000. This is correct and intentional.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (24/25 tested requirements pass; 1 design issue with Clear & Close button z-index in preview environment)

seed_data_creation: Added TEST_FilterLender_SE lender (accepts_self_employed=true, accepts_adverse=true, proc_fee_purchase=0.45, max_ltv=90, loan range 50000-500000) for filter testing. Not cleaned up - still exists in DB. Can be deleted via Edit/Delete on Lenders page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ext 5 (Lender Filter Panel) and Login Commission Toast are implemented. Toast was broken due to wrong data path (FIXED in Login.js). Lender filter works: SE filter, Adverse filter, LTV calc, results pill (teal=matches, red=none, grey=no filters), clear filter, Match Lenders. Key issue: filter panel z-index (z-50=50) is less than Emergent badge (z-index:9999), making 'Clear & Close' button unclickable at 1080px viewport. TEST_FilterLender_SE was added during testing and should be cleaned up. All Commission Reminder and Pipeline features from iterations 1-3 still working.
rca_of_the_issue: Commission Reminder Toast Bug: In Login.js, axios.get returns a response object where .data is the HTTP response body: {success:true, data:{overdue:[],due_soon:[]}}. Code incorrectly accessed data.overdue and data.due_soon (which are undefined, returning length 0 via nullish coalescing). Correct path is data.data.overdue and data.data.due_soon. This caused the early return condition (overdueCount===0 && dueSoonCount===0) to always trigger, suppressing the toast entirely. Fix applied: added const reminders = data.data; and then used reminders?.overdue?.length and reminders?.due_soon?.length. Clear & Close Blocked: Emergent badge is position:fixed, z-index:9999, bottom:16px, right:16px, size 178x40px. Filter panel footer 'Clear & Close' button is inside panel (z-50=50), positioned in the bottom-right corner. At 1080px height the button's center (x=1760, y=1054) falls exactly within the badge's bounding box (x=1726-1904, y=1024-1064). elementFromPoint confirms the badge intercepts all clicks at that position.
